Star Rail FEST: Security Log 

Mechatron ID: G079-IRION

Duty Station: Star Rail FEST: Penacony Exhibition Area

Duty Mode: Standard Mode/High Alert Mode

Log Recorder: G-079 (Self-Recording)

06:30 A.M.   Shift Begins

System check complete. Energy at 100%, sensors operating normally. Linking to venue surveillance system.
Commencing patrol on designated route. Foot traffic steady, all clear.

===============================================

09:30 A.M.   Incident 001
Description: 2 visitors attempted to climb the Great Septimus stand without any safety measures in place.
Response Measures: Relevant warnings have been issued, and large set props such as stands have been added to the priority patrol list.

09:30 A.M.   Incident 002
Description: One artist, live-sketching an imagenae version of the "Origami Bird" at their booth, drew massive crowds of bird-watchers and photographers, causing severe traffic congestion.
Response Measures: Crowds promptly dispersed and visitors organized into orderly queues.

(...)

09:30 A.M.   Incident 123
Description: 8 visitors misused on-site self-service SoulGlad machines in an attempt to organize a "SoulGlad Splash Festival," resulting in contamination of portions of the venue and affecting nearby pedestrians and stalls.
Response Measures: Temporarily detained the individuals involved for conduct and safety education, and finalized a compensation plan.

08:35 P.M.   Incident 124
Description: 13 cosplayers attempted to draw a large magic summoning circle in the center of the venue to recreate the "Holy Grail War."
Response Measures: Relevant education on proper conduct has been administered, and the perpetrators have been supervised in cleaning up their graffiti from the floor.

(...)

09:35 P.M.   Incident 233
Description: A total of 35 visitors and cosplayers gathered around the Great Septimus stand before closing time, attempting to organize a "Harmonious Choir" summoning ceremony.
Response Measures: Crowd was promptly dispersed and the area cleared. No stampede incidents occurred.

===============================================

10:00 A.M.   Shift Complete
Shift Summary:
233 incidents handled today. No injuries or major property damage.
Venue cleared. System enters standby maintenance state.

Unofficial Record: 
[Mechatron Expletive]
Power remaining at 15%, consumption 250% higher than expected.

---End of Log Record---
